title: Construct order-17 Gaussian-dyadic Clifford attaining native rank eight (no κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers the order-17 existence question in Nick Petalas's #6192 with an explicit four-qubit Gaussian-dyadic Clifford:
`U17 = i S_3 CZ_03 CZ_12 CZ_23 H_g^(tensor 4)`, where `H_g=(1+i)[[1,1],[1,-1]]/2`.

The actual matrix satisfies `Phi17(U17)=0`, has order 17, trace −1, symplectic defect rank eight and native B rank four. Applying #6192's Bell-spectator method on four additional qubits gives `B=[[I,A+I],[I,I]]` of rank eight. This attains the predecessor's cap for every ambient width M>=8. The new contribution is this explicit instance and its exact certificate; the general cap and Bell method retain predecessor credit.

Scoped construction plus written proof and complete finite checks. **No new κ or selected-frontier change.** Source/consumer matching, native chronology, ownership, dirty restoration, the complete paid/target invoice and supplier admission remain open.

## Validation

Publication head: `4e3f55105e436dfa364029f9032c90f6a239fbe0`. CPython 3.12.14, macOS arm64, standard library only.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/order-seventeen-clifford
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/order-seventeen-clifford --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Both registered checkers pass normally and under optimized Python. Primary coverage: complete 16×16 unitarity, order and polynomial identities; all sixteen nonidentity powers; eight signed Pauli-generator images; the full binary Bell conjugation; seven hypothesis controls. The separately written checker uses unreduced Gaussian integers and imports no primary code. The 256-dimensional polynomial identity is derived by tensor/conjugation in the proof, not claimed as a dense replay.

Committed bytes/modes and declared source history pass. The official export passes integrity checking, and all four direct replays pass from a read-only, Git-free export with empty PATH; all 11 files including its receipt retain their bytes and modes. Corrupting a retained source document is rejected under optimized Python. A separate AI mathematical audit found no blockers.

Not run: selected scientific cold replay, physical/native supplier replay, Lean/formal-kernel proof or independent human review. Prior binding-only orientation was reused after confirming all 1227 bound inputs were unchanged; no fresh scientific replay is implied. Hosted CI is pending at submission.
